label: rejected

evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette read as a wall torch, but the top view is an unreadable orange blob; capped by a visible seating failure (the bracket ring is not connected to the plate).
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: plate and handle (big), cup and flame (medium), ring, bolt nub and gold rim (small).
evidence.V3: The flame is a single faceted gem or candy-corn cone with horizontal colour bands, not a flame shape; the handle hangs in front of the plate with no arm; capped at 1 by the seating issue.
evidence.V4: Mix of treatments: the plate has crisp chamfers, the handle is smooth-rounded and the flame is hard low-poly faceting, so it is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Stray faceting on the flame (close_flame_studio), a jagged gold rim edge at the cup, and the ring sits off a hex stub that does not reach it (close_bracket_studio).
evidence.V6: Flame hue in three values, wood brown, ink iron and a gold rim; disciplined, and colourways swap only the flame.
evidence.V7: 600 tris, exactly the small target of 600.
evidence.V8: Single vertex-colour material and the ink/gold accents match the kit, but the gem-faceted flame clashes with the kit's smooth weighted-normal shading.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch off, back-centre origin, PointLight note, white MeshPart.

artifacts: Bracket ring floats in front of the plate; the hex stub arm does not visibly connect to it
Jagged irregular gold rim between flame and cup
top_fixes: Add a proper bracket arm from the plate to the ring (or an L-arm under the cup) so the torch is visibly held
Remodel the flame as a smooth-shaded teardrop with two or three licking tongues and vertical rather than horizontal colour gradation
Clean the gold rim into an even chamfered band
